description: This file defines a class 'NetworkDays' which provides functionality to calculate the number of working days between two dates, excluding weekends and specified holidays. It includes methods to handle array inputs, date calculations, and holiday exclusions, serving as part of a spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: NetworkDays
classes.description: A class providing a method to calculate the number of working days between two dates, considering weekends and holidays, as part of a spreadsheet calculation library.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Calculates the number of working days between startDate and endDate, optionally excluding specified holidays. Handles both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: calcStartDow
methods.description: Calculates the day of the week index for the start date, adjusted to a custom scale.

methods.name: calcEndDow
methods.description: Calculates the day of the week index for the end date, adjusted for weekend considerations.

methods.name: calcPartWeekDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of weekdays in a partial week based on start and end day indices.

methods.name: applySign
methods.description: Applies the sign to the result based on the order of start and end dates.
